## Appearance

Anne is a tall, slim girl with a pointed, freckled face, a little pointed chin, and a milk-white throat. Her expressive face features delicate, flower-like traits, including a nice, freckled nose—sometimes bearing seven distinct freckles—and pale cheeks with everchanging rosy flushes. She possesses big, starry gray eyes that are described as solemn, luminous, or limpid. Her hair, worn long in red braids early on, was once closely shingled after a period of being green; over time, her bright, torrent-like hair is variously described as plain red, auburn, or splendid [Titian](../character/titian.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P0](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers P12](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER VIII. ## Personality

Highly imaginative, poetic, and idealistic, she possesses a transparent nature coupled with a strong optimism and a stubborn, intense spirit. Though initially talkative, she eventually becomes much quieter, even as she remains heedless, impulsive, and prone to reckless mistakes that she takes very seriously. She demonstrates practical skills, such as a knack with children, treating croup, rowing a dory, and singing with a good voice, though she harbors a strong fear of the [Haunted Wood](../codex/places.md#haunted-wood) after dark. Motivated by a desire to bring beauty to life, she aims to learn how to best live her life to understand and help both herself and others. In her pursuits as an educator, she strives to be loved and remembered by her pupils as a genuine helper. Furthermore, she works hard to pass examinations, win the Avery scholarship, and attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) for higher education.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P3](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P24](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0024), [v1 CHAPTER X. ## History

Born in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke), [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia), Anne Shirley was orphaned at three months old and spent her early childhood living with Mrs. [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md), Mrs. [Hammond](../character/hammond.md), and in an asylum. Adopted by siblings [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) to live at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), Anne formed an immediate, lifelong bond with her neighbor [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), though her fiery temper caused initial friction with Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) and classmate [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). Over the next few years, she excelled in her studies under Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md), formed a story club, and tied for first place on the [Island](../codex/places.md#island) with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) on the Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) entrance examinations. Following Matthew's sudden death from heart failure, Anne gave up her college scholarship to stay at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to care for [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and teach at the local school, reconciling with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) after he gave up his teaching post so she could work in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). As a schoolteacher, she co-founded the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), accidentally sold her neighbor Mr. Harrison's cow, and convinced [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to permanently adopt the orphaned Keith twins, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md). She also established deep friendships with young [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) and the reclusive Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), ultimately reuniting Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) with Paul's father. After two years of teaching and helping improve her community, Anne prepared to leave [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) to pursue her education at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) alongside her childhood friends.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P13](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER V. ## Quotes

> "Pretty well. I’m better at looking after children, though. I’ve had so much experience at that. It’s such a pity you haven’t any here for me to look after."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P24](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0024)

> “I think he’s lovely,” said Anne reproachfully. “He is so very sympathetic. He didn’t mind how much I talked—he seemed to like it. I felt that he was a kindred spirit as soon as ever I saw him.”
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P26](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0026)

> "Oh, I don’t mean that sort of a name. I mean just a name you gave it yourself. Didn’t you give it a name? May I give it one then? May I call it—let me see—Bonny would do—may I call it Bonny while I’m here? Oh, do let me!"
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P33](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0033)

> "Pretty well. I imagine a good deal, and that helps to pass the time. Of course, it’s rather lonesome. But then, I may as well get used to that."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P11](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0011)

> "I don’t get cross about other things; but I’m so tired of being twitted about my hair and it just makes me boil right over. Do you suppose my hair will really be a handsome auburn when I grow up?"
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P43](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0043)

## Relationships

### [Allan](../character/allan.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/allan--anne-shirley.md)

Mrs. Allan is a valued friend and Sunday school teacher to Anne, serving as an extra conscience for her [R1, R2]. Their relationship began with a humorous mishap when Anne accidentally flavored Mrs. Allan's tea party cake with liniment, but Mrs. Allan kindly comforted her [S1, S2]. They remain close confidantes who take walks together and share thoughtful conversations about life, teaching, grief, and friendship [S3, S5].

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--diana-barry.md)

[Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) is Anne's closest friend and schoolmate, having sworn eternal friendship with her early in their acquaintance [R4, S7]. Together they participate in social causes such as the [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) committee [R5] and endure various childhood misadventures [S11, S15, S17]. Anne also proved her devotion by saving Diana's sister during a medical emergency, solidifying their bond and gaining the [Barry](../character/barry.md) family's lasting gratitude [S10].

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--gilbert-blythe.md)

Anne and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) began as bitter academic rivals after [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) insulted her hair, leading to years of competition to be first in their class [R7, S8, S13, S14]. Although [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) harbored romantic feelings for Anne and rescued her from a sinking boat, Anne initially spurned his advances [R8, R9, S16]. Eventually, the two reconciled their feud and agreed to become best friends who assist one another with their studies [R6, S100].

Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) is a quaint, romantic woman living at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) who became close friends with Anne after Anne stumbled upon her house [R35, S77]. They share a deep affection and imaginative nature, confiding in one another over tea parties and discussing past romances [S78, S96].

_Sources: [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P4](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0004), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P10](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0010), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P17](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0017), +3 more_

- Friend of — visiting friends who share affection and confidences (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P32](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0032), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P34](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0034)</sub>

### [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--paul-irving.md)

[Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) is one of Anne's school pupils who quickly became her kindred spirit and confidant [R36, R37]. Anne acts as an encouraging mentor to him, bonding deeply over shared feelings about imagination, grief, and memory [S99, S100].

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P7](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0007), +13 more_
